note: Route-graph ratchet baseline (no-new-rot ratchet). Each entry is the CURRENT reachable-first-party-module-count ceiling for a LOCKED FIXED_ROUTES route (the primary dev-perf 'first-party graph pressure' metric from scripts/route-graph.mjs). The gate fails when a tracked route's count grows BEYOND its ceiling and when the committed baseline raises any ceiling vs the base branch WITHOUT a matching absorb record. Counts are captured WITH the companion extension repos cloned pinned (exactly as CI does via clone-extensions) so they reproduce in CI. Regenerate with `node scripts/audit/route-graph-ratchet.mjs --write-baseline` after cloning the extensions — a ceiling should only ever be LOWERED as barrel imports are narrowed, and is never raised SILENTLY. A sanctioned raise must be ANNOTATED: a sibling `absorbs` record `route -> { from, to, reason, pr }` whose from/to exactly match the raise vs the base branch (from = the base ceiling, to = the new committed ceiling, reason = why the growth is accepted, pr = the PR carrying the absorbed change). The gate validates records strictly (malformed/stale/orphan records fail closed; a carried-forward record may not be deleted while its raised ceiling is kept) and prints a LOUD NOTICE line for every absorbed raise. The tracked route set is route-graph.mjs FIXED_ROUTES; change it there, then regenerate.

/api/a2a.reason: cinatra#2815 S3 (epic #2812), the runtime delivery slice. TWO pure leaves become reachable, and no other module. (1) packages/agents/src/effective-assigned-skills.ts — the effective-5 assignment chain (project -> user -> team(s) -> organization -> workspace over the run's IMMUTABLE assignment-scope snapshot, first-seen dedupe, at most five distinct skills per run), imported statically by src/lib/agent-assigned-skills-injection.ts, which every tracked graph already reaches through the assigned-skill tier of src/lib/agents-store.ts. (2) src/lib/assistant-assigned-skills-delivery.ts — the assistant delivery seam together with the one thread read it needs, reached from the assistant runtime. packages/agents/src/assignment-scope-snapshot.ts, which both of them consume, was ALREADY in all four graphs through the run-creation store, so it adds nothing here. NARROWING IS UNAVAILABLE. scripts/route-graph.mjs counts a dynamic import() specifier as exactly the same first-party graph pressure as a static one (the metric is static reachability by design), so making either edge lazy would not lower the measured count; the seam's thread read is already folded INTO the seam module rather than kept as a second leaf for precisely this reason; and the remaining edge is the slice itself — delivering a run's assigned skills without reading the scopes its creation froze is the defect this change exists to fix. The branch adds no other first-party module to any tracked graph: its other new files are tests, which the analyzer does not walk. MEASURED, NOT COMPUTED, with the companion extension fleet cloned PINNED exactly as CI clones it (116/116, missingCount 0 on every route) by the same scripts/route-graph.mjs in ONE environment: the four tracked graphs measure /api/mcp 1770, /chat 1872, /api/a2a 1778, /api/llm-bridge 1788 against committed ceilings of 1768, 1870, 1776 and 1786 — +2 on each, the two leaves above. /sign-in is untouched by this slice: its ceiling and its carried-forward record are left EXACTLY as committed, neither raised nor ratcheted down from a measurement this change has no business making. The records the base branch carried for these four routes are RETIRED BY THIS RAISE, which is the one lifecycle the gate allows for an annotation whose ceiling moves. `pr` is 0 — the sanctioned 'no pull request yet' value — because the pull request carrying this change is opened after the baseline is written; it is filled in with the real number by the change that opens it.
